note: v502: Accessibility and housekeeping pass. Tappable rows and cards only became keyboard- and VoiceOver-operable when you navigated to a page — so as soon as a list redrew itself (typing in a search box, changing a filter, saving or deleting something) its rows went back to being unreachable, and the notification centre never was reachable at all. That sweep now follows every redraw automatically. Also: deleting an invoice used to leave the receipt photos of its billed expenses sitting in storage forever.
